landing.title: Tennis Match Tracker
landing.description: Track your matches, manage opponents and partners, and build your game with learning-first stats and AI-ready preparation.
landing.footer: Use your Google account to sign in. New users create an account on first sign-in.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your Google account to use Tennis Match Tracker.

onboarding.title: Create your account
onboarding.description: You’re signed in with Google. Complete your account to start using Tennis Match Tracker. Profile details below are optional—you can update them anytime under My Account.

sparkline.subtitle: Each match on the timeline — color is the result; height is the games differential.
sparkline.empty: No matches match the current filters.
sparkline.hint: Tap a marker for match details

byType.title: Win / loss by match type
byType.subtitle: Singles and doubles only (competitive matches).

players.emptyDefault: Add opponents and partners you play with to track them here.

form.name: Name

scoreSegments.emptyOptional: Add sets or tie breaks if you want to note the partial score.

account.title: My Account
account.languageDescription: Used for the app interface, speech-to-text on match notes, and AI match preparation advice.
account.profileDescription: Your play style, strengths, and weaknesses are sent to the AI when you request match preparation advice. All fields are optional.
account.googleIdentityHint: Name and email come from Google. To change them, update your Google account.
account.playStyleHelp: How you usually play—optional; you can add or change this anytime.
account.strengthsPlaceholder: What you do well on court (optional)

prepare.title: Match preparation
prepare.description: For singles matches only. Pick an opponent and upcoming match date to get tactical advice and a game plan. You can also review advice you saved earlier.
prepare.historyEmpty: No saved advice for this opponent yet.
prepare.advicePlaceholder: Your tactical advice and game plan will appear here.
prepare.noPlayers: Add at least one player before requesting match preparation.
prepare.deleteConfirm: Delete this saved advice? This cannot be undone.
